prerequisites.reason: Activation functions are integral to the functioning of neural networks.
Understanding neural networks requires knowledge of how layers are structured.
Prediction layers are a specific type of layer structure in neural networks.
Training techniques are applied to neural networks.
Backpropagation is a specific training technique used for neural networks.
Loss functions are essential for evaluating the effectiveness of training techniques.
Model evaluation relies on loss functions to assess performance.
Mapping functions are used to transform inputs in neural networks.
General concepts provide foundational knowledge necessary for understanding neural networks.
